chosen.premise: When injured, Moltres is said to dip its body into molten magma to burn and heal itself.
chosen.hook: Moltres’s healing method is literally a volcano.
chosen.visualIdea: Show an injured Moltres diving into a volcano, then emerging restored through a fiery reveal.
chosen.note: A highly distinctive healing mechanic, directly repeated in two Pokédex entries, with an immediately readable volcano transformation.

candidates.premise: Galarian Moltres keeps the same 2-meter height but changes from Fire/Flying to Dark/Flying and weighs 6 kg more.
candidates.hook: Moltres changes its type—and gets heavier without getting taller.
candidates.visualIdea: Use a split-screen stat card: 2 m on both sides, then types and weight flip from 60 to 66 kg.
candidates.note: A precise, defensible comparison with a strong on-screen stat reveal; slightly less emotionally compelling than Moltres healing in magma.

candidates.premise: Moltres turns every wing flap into a fire display, from scattered embers to dazzling flashes and flares.
candidates.hook: For Moltres, flying means setting the sky on fire.
candidates.visualIdea: Animate each wingbeat producing a different escalation: flash, embers, then a huge flame flare.
candidates.note: Strongly supported and visually dynamic, but the basic idea of a fire bird producing flames while flying is relatively expected.

candidates.premise: Moltres’s arrival is linked to spring: it migrates from the south and can bring spring to wintry lands.
candidates.hook: This legendary fire bird is also a seasonal forecast.
candidates.visualIdea: Follow clues from frozen terrain to a southern flight path, ending with Moltres’s arrival and spring.
candidates.note: The seasonal connection and south-to-spring migration are concrete and well supported, though the premise is less instantly dramatic than magma healing.

candidates.premise: Moltres’s flame-cloaked wings are said to light paths for people lost in the mountains.
candidates.hook: Moltres can be a rescue beacon, not just a battle legend.
candidates.visualIdea: Show a dark mountain trail appearing step by step as Moltres’s glowing wings illuminate it.
candidates.note: A charmingly unexpected rescue role with excellent visuals, but it rests on a single Pokédex entry and is framed as a story rather than a confirmed behavior.

candidates.premise: Moltres is a legendary Pokémon whose evolution chain contains only Moltres, with no earlier or later stage.
candidates.hook: Moltres has no evolution story—its chain starts and ends here.
candidates.visualIdea: Build an evolution chain with a single Moltres node, then erase every imagined predecessor and successor.
candidates.note: Accurate and concrete, but many legendary Pokémon have one-stage evolution chains, making the angle broad and low-impact.

rounds.request: None—magma-healing is strong enough. A stronger alternative would need an equally specific, surprising Moltres-only rule or contradiction with multiple direct Pokédex sources and a more distinctive visual payoff.
